# 01 Cut

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** A changes to B between two consecutive frames, with no in-between frames.

**Test.** Step through frame by frame: does any frame mix A and B? If not, it is a Cut.

**Not here.** A cut with added motion blur is 05 Motion › Whip. A cut hidden under a flash is 09 Light › Flash.

**Build.** Holds guides, references and sound-hit templates rather than overlays.

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Match Cut](match-cut/) | A and B share a form, motion, colour or composition, so the eye carries across. | circle → moon, door slam → gavel |
| [Smash Cut](smash-cut/) | An abrupt jump in tone, volume or energy, for contrast or comedy. | silence → loud party |
| [Jump Cut](jump-cut/) | The same subject with a jump in time. | vlog cuts, montage of a drawing appearing |
| [Audio-Led](audio-led/) | Sound leads or trails the picture (J/L cuts), or a sound hit drives the cut. | B's audio under A, whoosh into a hard cut |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Anchored Match Cut](match-cut/match-cut-anchor/) | Match Cut | A hard cut that lines up a point in the next scene with a point in the old one, then eases the new scene back to its own framing. |
| [Smash Cut with Shake](smash-cut/smash-cut-shake/) | Smash Cut | A hard cut to the next scene, which lands with a short, decaying camera shake. |
| [Strobe Cut](smash-cut/strobe-cut/) | Smash Cut | Cuts back and forth between the two scenes faster and faster, then lands on the new one. |
| [Punch-in Jump Cut](jump-cut/jump-cut-punch/) | Jump Cut | Cuts to the next shot framed tighter, then cuts again to the normal framing: the vlog punch-in for emphasis. |
